function getCarState(car,t){
  const sp = pchipEval(car.sCurve,t);
  const dp = pchipEval(car.dCurve,t);
  const s=sp.v, d=dp.v, speed=sp.d1, accel=sp.d2, latSpeed=dp.d1;
  const f=frameAt(s);
  const pos=f.p.clone().addScaledVector(f.n,d);
  const t1=Math.max(0,t-0.05), t2=Math.min(40,t+0.05);
  const p1=getCarPositionAt(car,t1), p2=getCarPositionAt(car,t2);
  let forward=p2.clone().sub(p1);
  if(forward.lengthSq()<1e-6) forward.copy(f.t);
  forward.normalize();
  const yaw=Math.atan2(forward.x,forward.z);
  const pitch=-Math.asin(THREE.MathUtils.clamp(forward.y,-1,1));
  // curvature and lat acc
  const f2=frameAt(s+1.0);
  let dyaw = Math.atan2(f2.t.x,f2.t.z) - Math.atan2(f.t.x,f.t.z);
  while(dyaw>Math.PI) dyaw-=2*Math.PI; while(dyaw<-Math.PI) dyaw+=2*Math.PI;
  const curv=dyaw; // per meter? s+1
  const latAcc = speed*speed*curv;
  return {s,d,speed,accel,latSpeed,pos,forward,yaw,pitch,curv,latAcc,frame:f};
}
```

function makePchip(xs, ys){
  const n=xs.length;
  const h=new Array(n-1), delta=new Array(n-1);
  for(let i=0;i<n-1;i++){ h[i]=xs[i+1]-xs[i]; delta[i]=(ys[i+1]-ys[i])/h[i]; }
  const m=new Array(n).fill(0);
  m[0]=delta[0]; m[n-1]=delta[n-2];
  for(let i=1;i<n-1;i++){
    if(delta[i-1]*delta[i] <= 0){ m[i]=0; }
    else { const w1=2*h[i]+h[i-1]; const w2=h[i]+2*h[i-1]; m[i]=(w1+w2)/(w1/delta[i-1]+w2/delta[i]); }
  }
  return {xs,ys,h,m,n};
}
function pchipEval(p,t){
  const xs=p.xs, ys=p.ys, m=p.m;
  if(t<=xs[0]) { return {v:ys[0], d1:0, d2:0}; } // maybe derivative 0
  if(t>=xs[p.n-1]) { return {v:ys[p.n-1], d1:m[p.n-1], d2:0}; }
  let lo=0, hi=p.n-1;
  while(hi-lo>1){ const mid=(lo+hi)>>1; if(xs[mid]<=t) lo=mid; else hi=mid; }
  const hh=p.h[lo]; const s=(t-xs[lo])/hh; const s2=s*s; const s3=s2*s;
  const h00=2*s3-3*s2+1, h10=s3-2*s2+s, h01=-2*s3+3*s2, h11=s3-s2;
  const v=h00*ys[lo]+h10*hh*m[lo]+h01*ys[lo+1]+h11*hh*m[lo+1];
  const d1=((6*s2-6*s)*ys[lo]+(3*s2-4*s+1)*hh*m[lo]+(-6*s2+6*s)*ys[lo+1]+(3*s2-2*s)*hh*m[lo+1])/hh;
  const d2=((12*s-6)*ys[lo]+(6*s-4)*hh*m[lo]+(-12*s+6)*ys[lo+1]+(6*s-2)*hh*m[lo+1])/(hh*hh);
  return {v,d1,d2};
}

let lastFrameTime = null;
function animate(now){
  if(lastFrameTime===null){ lastFrameTime=now; }
  const rawDt=(now-lastFrameTime)/1000;
  lastFrameTime=now;
  const dt=Math.min(Math.max(rawDt,0),0.1);
  if(state==='COUNTDOWN'){
    countdownElapsed += dt;
    const n = countdownElapsed < 1 ? 3 : countdownElapsed < 2 ? 2 : 1;
    countdownEl.textContent = String(n);
    countdownEl.style.display='block';
    if(countdownElapsed >= 3){
      state='PLAYING'; hideCountdown(); simTime=0; lastEventTime=0; setIcons(true);
    }
  }
  if(state==='PLAYING'){
    simTime = Math.min(DURATION, simTime + dt*playbackSpeed);
    scrubber.value = simTime.toFixed(3);

  renderAt(simTime);

  requestAnimationFrame(animate);
}

function makePchip(xs, ys){
  const n=xs.length;
  const h=new Array(n-1), delta=new Array(n-1);
  for(let i=0;i<n-1;i++){ h[i]=xs[i+1]-xs[i]; delta[i]=(ys[i+1]-ys[i])/h[i]; }
  const m=new Array(n).fill(0);
  m[0]=delta[0]; m[n-1]=delta[n-2];
  for(let i=1;i<n-1;i++){
    if(delta[i-1]*delta[i] <= 0){ m[i]=0; }
    else { const w1=2*h[i]+h[i-1]; const w2=h[i]+2*h[i-1]; m[i]=(w1+w2)/(w1/delta[i-1]+w2/delta[i]); }
  }
  return {xs,ys,h,m,n};
}

let lastFrameTime = null;

  if(lastFrameTime===null){ lastFrameTime=now; }

    const n = countdownElapsed < 1 ? 3 : countdownElapsed < 2 ? 2 : 1;

    simTime = Math.min(DURATION, simTime + dt*playbackSpeed);

  if(forward.lengthSq()<1e-6) forward.copy(f.t);
  forward.normalize();

  const curv=dyaw; // per metre

It could be visible? At y=0, z=-0.12, near floor. It's a 1.6 wide plate. Might be okay but not intended. We can remove. But not critical. Better remove to avoid weird. We'll edit later.
